title: Announcing The Headline Sponsors
body: Thank you to HP, Nebula, and Ubuntu Supported By Canonical for becoming the Headline Sponsors of the 2012 OpenStack Conference in San Francisco. There are still opportunties to be a Premeir Sponsor, Event Sponsor, or Startup Sponsor. See below for details about Sponsorship.
